{{Quote|Callos was like Felucia. Overgrown, teeming with life. And we razed the planet. It's a dead world now.|[[Juno Eclipse/Legends|Juno Eclipse]], to [[Galen Marek|Starkiller]]|<ref name="Star Wars: The Force Unleashed (comic)">[[Star Wars: The Force Unleashed (graphic novel)|''Star Wars: The Force Unleashed'' graphic novel]]</ref>}}
'''Callos''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of the [[Brema sector/Legends|Brema sector]] in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. It was once teeming with animal and [[Plant/Legends|plant]] life, until it was [[Bombing of Callos|devastated]] by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] in [[3 BBY/Legends|3 BBY]].

==Description==
{{Quote|<nowiki></nowiki>''Lost''? No we're not ''lost''! I know ''exactly'' where we're headed!|[[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]], to [[Kit Fisto/Legends|Kit Fisto]]|<ref name="UTH" />}}
[[File:Callos_wildlife.jpg|thumb|left|250px|Wildlife on Callos]]
Before its [[Bombing of Callos|devastation]], Callos was a [[Jungle/Legends|jungle]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] with a sweltering environment, which was home to many species of tree and beast.<ref name="UTH" /> The [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] bombardment destroyed much of the planet's lush surface, and sent the formerly fertile environment into a permanent winter that killed anything that survived the initial assault.<ref name="TFUCG" />

==History==
===Clone Wars===
{{Quote|<nowiki></nowiki>''No'' ships or speeders, that was the cost of entry, ''Master Fisto''. The backers of this meeting are naturally suspicious of newcomers.|[[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]], to [[Kit Fisto/Legends|Kit Fisto]]|<ref name="UTH" />}}
During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], Callos remained a neutral [[Planet/Legends|planet]], rebuffing representatives from both the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] to support their causes.<ref name="TFUCG" />
However, Callos was the site of a [[Black market/Legends|black market]] [[Clawfish Roaming Auction of Illicit and Illegal Weaponry|operation]] run by [[Outlaw tech/Legends|outlaw tech]] [[Clawfish]]. In around [[20 BBY/Legends|20 BBY]], [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Kit Fisto/Legends|Kit Fisto]] and [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]] went on a [[Mission to Callos|mission]] to Callos to prevent the ''[[Venomator]]'', a highly advanced [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] designed by [[Geonosian/Legends|Geonosian]] [[Engineer/Legends|engineer]] [[Bogg]], from falling into the wrong hands.<ref name="UTH" />

===Imperial Period===
{{Quote|I ''led'' the Imperial forces at the Battle of Callos.|[[Juno Eclipse/Legends|Juno Eclipse]], to [[Galen Marek|Starkiller]]|<ref name="Star Wars: The Force Unleashed (comic)" />}}
[[File:Battle_of_callos.jpg|thumb|left|200px|The [[Bombing of Callos]]]]
In [[3 BBY/Legends|3 BBY]], [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Imperial Military/Legends|forces]] under the command of [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] [[Bombing of Callos|attacked]] Callos, after discovering evidence that the [[Callosian]]s were developing a new offensive technology intended to oppose those who were spreading the [[New Order/Legends|New Order]]. During the bombardment, Vader ordered his personal fighter wing, [[Black Eight Squadron]], to destroy the [[Callos planetary reactor]]. [[Juno Eclipse/Legends|Juno Eclipse]], leader of the bombing squad, asked Darth Vader if there was an alternative to outright genocide. Vader replied that striking the planetary reactor would suffice. The destruction of this reactor unit started a catastrophic chain reaction, which destroyed the ecosystem of the entire planet. Though the [[Atmosphere/Legends|atmosphere]] remained breathable, incessant ice storms and sub-freezing temperatures prevented any further permanent habitation.<ref name="TFUCG" />

==Inhabitants==
{{Quote|With respect, sir, it would be genocide to maintain the bombardment&mdash;a completely unnecessary waste of life. They are already beaten.|[[Juno Eclipse/Legends|Juno Eclipse]], to [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]]|<ref name="TFUN" />}}
The reclusive [[Callosian]]s developed a sophisticated culture, centered on a lifestyle of scholarship and philosophy. At various times throughout history, small groups of Callosians left their [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] to learn about the greater [[The galaxy/Legends|galaxy]], and always returned to share their knowledge with their society. Those who were away from the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] at the time of the [[Bombing of Callos|bombardment]] defied logic and returned to their devastated homeworld, presumably to [[Death/Legends|die]]. [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Imperial Survey Corps|surveys]] that returned later found no life signs on the planet's surface and no evidence of survivor enclaves.<ref name="TFUCG" />
